notes.title: Just released and already v0.2 is here!
notes.content:
This update includes several minor improvements:
[list]
[*] Hands align better with controllers
[*] Look and size of menu screen improved
[*] Settings distributed into sub-groups for better inclusion of future setting options
[*] Music toggle is now a volume slider
[*] Settings made are now correctly saved 
[*] improved slide locomotion
[*] real world time now shown in menu
[*] Forest: Lighting slightly improved
[*] Forest: a buggy tree has been fixed
[*] Forest: some particle effects added
[/list]

Please enjoy!
